name: review-intc-day3-real
origin: real: the judged INTC position at its 2026-09-02 review facts (entry 90.75, stop 77.14, day 3/274, confidence 54); the first live would_open_today answer was NO on R:R 1.41 < 1.5

position.thesis: Nancy Pelosi purchased 50 deep-in-the-money INTC call options (strike $50, expiry June 2027) on 2026-07-24, paying $250K–$500K in premium. At the trade date, INTC was ~$92.37, making these calls approximately $42 in-the-money — roughly 84% ITM relative to strike. This is classic stock-replacement behavior: high delta, low extrinsic value, capital-efficient long exposure. It expresses directional conviction on INTC recovering/appreciating over the next ~11 months. INTC currently sits at $90.68, up ~24% above its 200-DMA ($73.04) but well below its 52-week high ($140.99, -35.7%). The stock has declined a modest -1.83% since the trade date, meaning the thesis has not been materially invalidated by price action and very little of the expected upside has been realized. The position signals a bullish outlook on INTC into mid-2027, likely reflecting expectations around Intel's ongoing restructuring, potential chip demand recovery, or government-related semiconductor tailwinds (CHIPS Act). However, INTC faces serious structural challenges (market share loss to AMD/NVIDIA, foundry struggles), and this single insider's conviction, while notable, does not independently establish a fundamental catalyst.
position.invalidation_condition: INTC breaks decisively below its 200-DMA (~$73), signaling structural deterioration rather than cyclical dislocation; or a major negative fundamental development (e.g., foundry business failure, loss of key government contracts, significant earnings miss) materially undermines the bull thesis.
